name: cpp-official-docs
instructions: The official documentation of C and C++, kept locally: cppreference.com (the C and C++ languages and standard libraries), CMake, Clang, the GNU Make manual and the GCC manual. Search with search_docs, then read one section with read_doc. Look it up rather than guess it.
search: Search the official documentation of C and C++: cppreference.com (the C and C++ languages and standard libraries), CMake, Clang, the GNU Make manual and the GCC manual. Returns 10 section ids at most.
